overviewParagraphs: Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club offers something genuinely rare in Asian golf tourism — an authentic rural experience where the course setting is as much the attraction as the game itself. Set among traditional Cambodian rice paddies and mature coconut palm groves near Phnom Penh's international airport, this course provides a window into the agricultural heart of Cambodia that no museum or city tour can replicate, all delivered from the seat of a golf cart with a caddie at your side.

The course design respects its rural environment — the routing works with the existing landscape features rather than imposing artificial drama, creating a natural, unhurried flow around the 18 holes that encourages taking in the surrounding fields, palms, and the peaceful sounds of rural Cambodian life. Water features from the rice paddy irrigation system are integrated into the layout, and the greens are consistently well-maintained despite the relatively modest green fee schedule.

For discerning golfers landing in Phnom Penh and looking for an immediate, accessible, and genuinely memorable first round, AGS often recommends Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club as the arrival-day option — close to the airport, no transport stress, and a culturally immersive experience that sets the tone perfectly for what Cambodia golf has to offer beyond its city-centre venues.

curatorBriefHtml: Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club is a premier Par 72 championship layout in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, crafted by P + Z Development (1999) and stretching to 6,538 Yards (Blue Tees) across a traditional rice paddies, coconut palms environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its native coconut palm canopies (Shaded tree-lined fairways) and broad flat fairways (Walkable and relaxing).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club (Excellent — near Phnom Penh airport) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Cambodia dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its attentive caddie support (Courteous local caddies), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Phnom Penh golf tour by AGS, Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club provides a distinct architectural test by P + Z Development that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.verdict: One of Cambodia's classic original layouts. Flat, walkable fairways lined with mature coconut palms and native floral beds provide an authentic and relaxing round of golf.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club in Phnom Penh, Cambodia is a Par 72 championship layout designed by P + Z Development (opened 1999), measuring 6,538 Yards (Blue Tees) within a traditional rice paddies, coconut palms setting. It is particularly noted for native coconut palm canopies (Shaded tree-lined fairways).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club operates under excellent — near phnom penh airport protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (attentive caddie support (Courteous local caddies)), and private VIP transfers from your Phnom Penh hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club's broad flat fairways (Walkable and relaxing) alongside native coconut palm canopies (Shaded tree-lined fairways). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.

faqs.q: What is the best time of year to play Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club?
faqs.a: November through May offers the best conditions at Royal Phnom Penh Golf Club.
